topic: Write a Blog about English Study(写一篇英语学习博客)
genre: 博客 / 议论(describe a problem in learning English + give advice)
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 5 Reading for Writing:write a blog about English study(描述一个英语学习中的困难 + 给出解决建议)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,你常逛一个中国学生学英语的论坛。请用英语写一篇约80词的博客,内容包括:① 清楚描述你在学英语时遇到的一个困难(如听力/口语礼貌/词汇);② 给出一两条解决这个困难的方法;③ 鼓励有同样困难的同学。注意:每句都要围绕中心、用代词正确指代。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. You often visit a forum where Chinese students discuss learning English. Write a blog (about 80 words) including: 1) a clear description of one problem you have in learning English (e.g. listening, being polite, vocabulary); 2) one or two ways to solve it; 3) some encouragement for classmates with the same problem.
points: 清楚描述困难(My biggest problem is … / I have trouble with …)
解决方法(One thing that works for me is … / You might try …)
鼓励同学(Don't give up — it gets easier!)
每句围绕中心、代词指代清楚
model_essay: Hi everyone! My biggest problem in learning English is listening. When native speakers talk fast, I can catch only a few words and miss the main idea. One thing that really works for me is listening to English radio every day, so I get used to the speed. I also record my own voice and compare it with the speaker's, which helps me hear my mistakes. If you have the same problem, don't give up — little by little, it gets much easier. We can all improve together!
model_translation: 大家好!我学英语最大的困难是听力。母语者说得快时,我只能听懂几个词,抓不住大意。对我真正有用的一个办法是每天听英语广播,这样就习惯了语速。我还会录下自己的声音和原声比较,帮我听出错误。如果你也有同样的问题,别放弃——一点一点地,会越来越容易。我们都能一起进步!

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:清楚描述困难 / 解决方法 / 鼓励同学
围绕一个困难展开、句句相关、代词指代清楚、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、定语从句等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 描述困难 My biggest problem is …
方法1 One thing that works for me is …
方法2 I also … , which helps me …
鼓励 If you have the same problem, don't give up — it gets easier.
key_expressions: My biggest problem in learning English is listening.
One thing that really works for me is listening to English radio every day.
I record my own voice and compare it with the speaker's.
Don't give up — little by little, it gets much easier.

high_sentences: My biggest problem in learning English is listening.
One thing that really works for me is listening to English radio every day.
I record my own voice and compare it with the speaker's, which helps me hear my mistakes.
Little by little, it gets much easier.

error_pairs.note: have trouble with sth 固定搭配。

error_pairs.wrong: The radio help me a lot.
error_pairs.correct: The radio helps me a lot.
error_pairs.note: 主语第三人称单数,动词加 s。

error_pairs.wrong: It is a way which I can improve.
error_pairs.correct: It is a way in which I can improve.
error_pairs.note: way 后从句缺方式状语,用 in which / that / 省略。

第2-3句 方法:One thing that works for me is … I also … , which helps me …
第4句 鼓励:If you have the same problem, don't give up — it gets easier!
